content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for WDRA Under Secretary (Administration & Finance) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.wdra.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority (WDRA) for filling up administrative positions on a deputation basis in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post notified under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notified post is Under Secretary (Administration & Finance) under the Administration and Finance department of the Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Under Secretary (Administration & Finance) post under the advertised notification number F. No. WDRA-HR0Dep(USAF)/1/2026-HR/2191.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for WDRA recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in offline mode through the proper channel along with necessary documents and attested copies of CRs for the last five years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications is 18 November 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the designated authority on or before this closing date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree from a Government recognised University or Institute along with required service experience in analogous posts or level 10 as specified.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the Under Secretary post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per Level-11 ranging from Rs. 67,700 to 2,08,700/- under the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of appointment for this deputation?
faq.answer: The appointment is made on a deputation basis initially for a period of three years, which may be extended as per the administrative requirements of WDRA.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Completed application forms along with all required documents must be sent to the Assistant Director (Human Resource), Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority, New Delhi.
